title: Soveraeign Phase (PROPOSED)
description: A time-bounded product campaign with an immutable exit definition. Ending a phase is two readings, not one: whether the operating window is over, and whether the exit was earned. Collapsing them is what lets a phase end by redefinition - the definition quietly narrows until the evidence on hand satisfies it, and the record then says the phase was earned. This contract refuses that by pinning the definition to a digest at the moment the phase opened and by requiring an unmet clause to name the custody that inherits it. Semantic constraints a schema cannot express - an exit clause claimed earned with no evidence, an unmet clause carried forward to nobody, a definition digest that no longer matches the document - are checked by scripts/sovcustody/phase.py and each has a fixture that defeats it.

definition.description: The documents that state the exit, pinned by digest. A later reader can prove the definition was not narrowed to fit the evidence, which is the failure this field exists to refuse.

execution_status.description: Whether the operating window is over. CLOSED says no further work is admitted under this phase; it says nothing about whether the exit was earned.

acceptance_status.description: Whether the exit was earned. NOT_EARNED is a truthful terminal and is not a failure grade; EARNED requires every clause EARNED and is settled by the seat the phase names, never by the seat that worked it.

terminal.description: The pair read as one word, for a reader who wants the headline. Derived from execution_status and acceptance_status and never written independently.

succeeded_by.description: The campaign that follows. Naming it is not the same as carrying obligations into it: an unmet clause names its own inheriting custody, because carried forward is not a terminal.

text.description: Quoted from the pinned definition, not paraphrased. A paraphrase is where a narrowed definition enters.

verdict.description: EARNED has evidence. SUBSTANTIALLY_EARNED is honest about a clause met in substance and not in full, and is never rounded up to EARNED. NOT_EARNED is the ordinary reading for a clause with no evidence. NOT_REACHED is for a clause that could not begin because it depends on the others.

reading.description: The observed state, in one sentence, with the command behind it.

evidence.description: Addresses a reader can check. Required once the verdict is EARNED.

held_by.description: The exit custody that inherits this clause when it is not earned. Required for any verdict other than EARNED: an unmet obligation carried forward to nobody is the failure this whole contract exists to name.
